entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... It don't look like those guys're[n]gettin' forced on, right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, uh... I'm talkin' about the Shadows[n]on the trains in Mementos.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They just line up on the platform... and[n]let 'emselves get taken away.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't that mean they're okay with goin'[n]down into the depths?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I'm not sure... Do you know, Mona?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well... there's no way to be sure unless[n]we go down and see the end of the line[n]ourselves...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Maybe it's some kinda paradise. It'd[n]make sense for them to wanna go[n]down there if that was it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A metaphorical Shangri-La for the[n]masses... Is such a place truly held[n]in the depths of this eerie Palace?
